dct_creator_sm: Strack, Maria (University of Waterloo, University of Waterloo Faculty of Environment). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8996-7271
dct_description_sm: Field measurements of methane emission via ebullition from Fletcher fen in southern Ontario. Data from an associated greenhouse experiment investigating the role of plant community on ebullition is also included. Additional methodological details are in the README file.
dct_title_s: Ebullition measurements and supporting data from a calcareous fen in southern Ontario
